question: Does a fixed Morgan random forest rank high-potency PFAS-free human DPP-4 compounds across held-out publications and Murcko scaffolds using the full public exact-IC50 dataset?
scope: Retrospective target-wide classification across heterogeneous DPP-4 IC50 assays. Assay conditions remain attached to observations and are not treated as numerically interchangeable. This is not prospective or clinical validation.

eligible_records.chemical_filter: ChEMBL parent structure passes the project's OECD 2021 saturated CF3/CF2 motif rule; aryl C-F alone is allowed.
eligible_records.data_validity_comment: Retain exact measurements with ChEMBL validity comments; report their counts, do not silently remove them.

parent_deduplication: Within the eligible dataset after prior-test exclusions, retain parent IDs with exactly one eligible activity row. Drop all parent IDs with more than one eligible record rather than pool values across assays.

split.train_test_scaffold_rule: Within each fold, remove every training parent whose Murcko scaffold appears in that fold's held-out publications; verify no parent or scaffold overlap.
split.similarity_rule: Also remove every training parent with chirality-enabled Morgan radius-2/2048-bit Tanimoto >0.50 to any parent in that fold's held-out set. Recompute and report the remaining maximum similarity.

features.fingerprint: RDKit Morgan/ECFP radius 2, 2048 bits, chirality enabled

baselines.nearest_neighbor: For each held-out compound, take the maximum Morgan Tanimoto to any training parent; score by the mean activity label among tied nearest parents. Rank by descending score, descending similarity, then parent ChEMBL ID.
baselines.random: Use each fold's positive prevalence as its average-precision baseline and report exact hypergeometric top-shortlist expectation.

evaluation.primary_metric: macro-average precision across the five publication-held-out folds
evaluation.shortlist: ceil(5% of each fold's held-out parent count)
evaluation.qualification_rule: The primary model qualifies only if its macro-average precision strictly exceeds both nearest-neighbor macro-average precision and mean fold prevalence, its average precision exceeds fold prevalence in at least 4 of 5 folds, and pooled top-5%-shortlist recovery is at least 1.25 times the exact random expectation.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report all fold-level metrics, counts, predictions, and exact random-recovery probabilities; no tuning or threshold changes after evaluation.

prohibitions: Do not use any held-out publication or scaffold for model fitting, threshold changes, or hyperparameter tuning within its fold.
Do not pool raw IC50 values across assays or publications.
Do not infer GLP-1 response, clinical exposure, safety, therapeutic equivalence, or calibrated potency from this benchmark.
Do not generate the main candidate pool unless this model passes the frozen qualification rule.
